title: CodedConcept
description: A generic reference into any clinical coding system (e.g. ICD-10-CM, SNOMED CT, LOINC). This schema defines only the shape of a coded reference — system, code, display — and deliberately does not assume or hardcode any specific terminology. Validating that `code` is a real, current code within `system` is out of scope for this repo; see the coding-system-neutrality note in the handover doc.

system.description: URI identifying the coding system this code belongs to, e.g. http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/icd-10-cm or http://snomed.info/sct.

display.description: Human-readable display text for the code.
